entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. Order number is 8675309.

Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me just pull up that order. One moment... Okay, I have it here. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's neither. I don't have time for a long back-and-forth. There was a family emergency. I just need a yes or no: can I return it?
I understand you're looking for a quick answer. I do need a bit more context to see what's possible. The return window can be strict.

Fine. My partner was scheduled for a military deployment, but it was moved up after a medical issue required immediate surgery. I was at the hospital for the last three weeks dealing with that whole emergency. The band is still in the box.

I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is okay now. Thank you for that information. Let me check the purchase date and review the policy for you. I see you received the VeloBand Pulse 27 days ago.
Good news. According to our system, all our items have a 90-day return window. Since it's only been 27 days, you are well within the timeframe for a full refund. No exception needed.
Oh. Great. That's a relief. What do I need to do?

I can process that for you right now. And given the situation with your partner's surgery and upcoming deployment, and since I see you're a VIP member with us, I'm going to email you a pre-paid express return label. I've also gone ahead and added a $50 store credit to your VeloFit account for any inconvenience. You can expect the full refund to your original payment method as soon as the carrier scans the return package.
Wow, okay. That's... very efficient. Thank you, Sarah. I appreciate it.
You're very welcome. The email with the label is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your partner a speedy recovery.
